axis: Every claim is a complete causal chain Input→Activity→Behavior→System→Economic→Loop. No adjective without a mechanism.

questions.question: Are causal connectives ('because', 'therefore', 'leads to', '→', 'drives') present at density ≥4/kw?
Does the document contain explicit mechanism chains (Input→Activity→Behavior or similar)?

questions.pattern: (anomaly detection|false-?positive rate|signal processing|<\s*\d+\s*ms|inference latency|model size|CAN bus|J1939|firmware delivery|signed firmware|telematics|knowledge graph)
questions.question: For each major capability claim, is a HOW mechanism explained (model type, signal, threshold)?

questions.pattern: (feedback loop|compounding|each new.+improves|network effect|fleet learning|knowledge graph grows|improves with use|gets smarter)
questions.question: Are at least 2 compounding feedback loops explicitly named?
Zero use of generic-consultant adjectives without immediate mechanism?
Does the executive section (first 2000 chars) show at least one full input→economic chain?
Does the doc explicitly reject chatbot/pilot pattern and explain why?
Is the compounding loop (each new unit improves prior units) explicitly stated?

questions.pattern: (if .+ fails|if .+ misses|if .+ extends|if .+ catches up|if .+ accelerates|risk if|fail-if)
questions.question: Are NEGATIVE mechanisms (what fails if X) also explained, not just positive ones?
